title:
*** Meet our Team ***

Hi, my names Melissa. I am a new support worker at Blue Pits Housing Action 

I have a pharmacy background, I have 6 years experience in the pharmaceutical industry. I am also a qualified makeup artist and aesthetics practitioner. 

In my spare time, I enjoy going to music concerts, having movie nights and listening to podcasts. 

So far this role has been really rewarding and enjoyable. I have loved getting to know all of the staff and tenants. I am looking forward to my future career as a support worker with Blue Pits.

#bluepitshousingaction #ourteam
#socialcare #supportwork
